doc.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Eddie Alley Day and the proclamation from Willie Brown
summary: Willie Brown, whom he once played for, gave him a day, and the supervisors a proclamation.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Being honored: NEA Jazz Masters and other awards

blocks.x: Oh my. And here’s Eddie Alley Day in San Francisco.

Oh, Willie Brown gave me that, had a day for me, the mayor. I played for him when he graduated from law school. And then the supervisors gave me a proclamation. Because like I said before, I never traveled like these other guys or nothing like that, I’m just local.
